about: A lock is a mould. Stretch every ceiling by the same factor and what stays red was never the ceiling's doing: it is a cell whose own origins do not meet, and no ceiling can hold it at any width.
Pouring another world into a lock counts the places it bounds that the world reaches.
Under use a lock deforms: what the world touched closes toward what was seen there, and what nothing touched opens.

cases.name: three hundred cells, five of them in conflict
